text:
eva: Kicking off v2 shadow launch for tenant routing now. Canary at 5% for 2 hours. Window 2026-03-20 18:00-20:00 UTC. Please monitor v2-canary alerts and call rollback if errors spike. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: /deploy v2 --mode=shadow --canary=5% --route=api/* --ticket=RD-2143

sam: Quick q — what's the explicit rollback threshold? 5% error rate or 2x baseline latency?

liam: Proposed rollback criteria: >3% 5xx over 5m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 10m. Also watch for sustained 4xx spikes that indicate schema changes.

carla: Heads-up: mobile SDKs need a short note in release notes about the header change. I'll prep a blurb. ping @maya for copy.

maya: Seen. I'll add migration snippet + cURL example. Example header: `X-Redwood-API-Version: 2` and a note about schema backward-compat.

ops: Monitoring pins created: dashboard "v2 shadow — errors & latency" and alert `v2-canary-error-5%`. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/v2-shadow-rollout

eva: Also remind CS that some tenants may be temporarily routed to v1. Carla, can you prep the support text?

deploy-bot: Canary traffic ramp to 5% complete in eu-west-1. Instances healthy: 12/12. Telemetry snapshot: baseline p95=120ms, current p95=140ms, errors=0.6%

noah: Noticing KV cache miss rate up ~8% for tenant acme-ops, digging into logs now.

liam: If KV miss >10% or errors spike for a single tenant, we should pin that tenant to v1. Pin API is admin-only.

ops: Pin API usage: `POST /admin/pins` body `{ "tenant": "<id>", "pin_version": "v1", "expires_at": "<ISO>" }` — requires infra token.

eva: Agreed. Conservative rule: if one tenant has >8% errors or >30% p95 regression, pin to v1 and notify them.

carla: Support blurb ready: "We're temporarily routing some requests to v1 to protect your traffic during a controlled v2 shadow launch." Will send on pin.

deploy-bot: Alert: v2-canary-error-5% triggered for tenant: acme-ops — 6.8% 5xx over 5m.

eva: Received. Noah, prioritize acme-ops. Liam, please prep pin command.

noah: Quick triage: errors from auth middleware, token decode timeouts in logs. Repro in staging shows same path hitting a blocking syscall.

liam: Ready to pin. Ops, what's the exact curl for runbook?

ops: Runbook step: `curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <infra>' https://admin.internal/pins -d '{"tenant":"acme-ops","pin_version":"v1","reason":"shadow-canary-errors","expires_at":"2026-03-21T00:00:00Z"}'`

deploy-bot: Pin request accepted. Tenant acme-ops pinned to v1. Confirmed: 100% of their traffic now on v1. Webhooks dispatched.

carla: CS notified + templated email sent to acme-ops: "We observed elevated errors during a controlled v2 shadow launch and have temporarily pinned your account to v1. No action needed."

maya: Release notes updated: migration example added and troubleshooting appendix about auth timeouts.

eva: We'll keep the canary running at 5% but stop any ramp. Ops, set alerts to watch regression back to baseline. If no more pins for 1 hour, we consider ramp to 20%.

deploy-bot: Canary paused automatically due to pin events. Current canary remains at 5%.

liam: Postmortem item: review token decode path and timeout defaults in auth lib.

noah: Opening PR with a targeted fix and adding a regression test for blocking syscalls in token path.

eva: Thanks all — standby for any other pin events. :thumbsup:
